column2:
table(n.)桌子、表格
(無詞性變化)
set the table 擺餐具
table tennis 桌球
Please put the books on the table.
(請把書放在桌上。)
Look at the table on page ten.
(請看第十頁的表格。)

tail(n.)尾巴
(無詞性變化)
wag its tail 搖尾巴
long tail 長尾巴
The dog is wagging its tail.
(那隻狗在搖尾巴。)
A monkey has a long tail.
(猴子有一條長尾巴。)

take(v.)拿、帶走、搭乘、花費(時間)
(無詞性變化)
take a bus 搭公車
take a picture 拍照
I take the MRT to school.
(我搭捷運上學。)
It takes ten minutes to get there.
(到那裡要花十分鐘。)

talk(v./n.)說話、談論、演講
talkative(adj.)健談的
talk to 和……說話
give a talk 演講
Can I talk to you for a minute?
(我可以跟你談一下嗎？)
We talked about the movie all night.
(我們整晚都在聊那部電影。)

tall(adj.)高的
(無詞性變化)
tall building 高樓
grow tall 長高
My brother is very tall.
(我哥哥很高。)
How tall are you?
(你多高？)

tape(n.)膠帶、錄音帶
(無詞性變化)
tape measure 捲尺
tape recorder 錄音機
I need some tape for this box.
(我需要一些膠帶來封這個箱子。)
Fix the poster with tape.
(用膠帶把海報貼好。)

taste(n./v.)味道、品嚐、品味
tasty(adj.)美味的
taste good 嚐起來很好吃
sweet taste 甜味
This soup tastes great.
(這湯很好喝。)
She has good taste in clothes.
(她穿衣服很有品味。)

taxicab(n.)計程車
taxi(n.)計程車
cab(n.)計程車(口語)
take a taxi 搭計程車
taxi driver 計程車司機
Let's take a taxi to the station.
(我們搭計程車去車站吧。)
The taxi driver was very kind.
(那位計程車司機很親切。)

tea(n.)茶
teapot(n.)茶壺
bubble tea 珍珠奶茶
a cup of tea 一杯茶
Would you like a cup of tea?
(你想喝杯茶嗎？)
Bubble tea is popular in Taiwan.
(珍珠奶茶在台灣很受歡迎。)

teach(v.)教
teacher(n.)老師
teaching(n.)教學
teach English 教英文
teach oneself 自學
My mom teaches English.
(我媽媽教英文。)
Can you teach me to swim?
(你可以教我游泳嗎？)

teacher(n.)老師
teach(v.)教
English teacher 英文老師
Teacher's Day 教師節
Our teacher is very nice.
(我們的老師人很好。)
We gave our teacher a card on Teacher's Day.
(我們在教師節送老師一張卡片。)

team(n./v.)隊伍、團隊、組隊
teammate(n.)隊友
teamwork(n.)團隊合作
school team 校隊
team up 組隊
He is on the school basketball team.
(他是校籃球隊的隊員。)
Let's team up for the project.
(我們一起組隊做這個專題吧。)

teenager(n.)青少年
teenage(adj.)青少年的
teen(n.)青少年(口語)
a typical teenager 典型的青少年
teenagers today 現今的青少年
Many teenagers love social media.
(許多青少年喜歡社群媒體。)
As a teenager, he loved music.
(他青少年時期熱愛音樂。)

telephone(n./v.)電話、打電話
phone(n./v.)電話、打電話(口語)
answer the phone 接電話
phone number 電話號碼
Can you answer the phone, please?
(可以請你接一下電話嗎？)
What's your phone number?
(你的電話號碼是多少？)

television(n.)電視
TV(n.)電視(縮寫)
watch TV 看電視
TV show 電視節目
I watch TV after dinner.
(我晚餐後看電視。)
What's your favorite TV show?
(你最喜歡的電視節目是什麼？)

tell(v.)告訴、講述、分辨
(無詞性變化)
tell a story 講故事
tell the truth 說實話
Please tell me the truth.
(請告訴我實話。)
Grandma told us a story.
(奶奶跟我們講了一個故事。)

temple(n.)廟、寺院
(無詞性變化)
Longshan Temple 龍山寺
visit a temple 參拜寺廟
We visited a temple in Lukang.
(我們參觀了鹿港的一間廟。)
Many people go to the temple on New Year's Day.
(許多人在新年去廟裡拜拜。)

tennis(n.)網球
(無詞性變化)
play tennis 打網球
tennis court 網球場
Let's play tennis this weekend.
(這個週末我們去打網球吧。)
There is a tennis court near my house.
(我家附近有一座網球場。)

terrible(adj.)可怕的、糟糕的
terribly(adv.)非常、極度地
feel terrible 感覺很糟
terrible weather 糟糕的天氣
The weather is terrible today.
(今天天氣糟透了。)
I feel terrible about the mistake.
(我對那個錯誤感到很難過。)

test(n./v.)測驗、考試、檢驗
(無詞性變化)
take a test 參加考試
pass a test 考試及格
We have a math test tomorrow.
(我們明天有數學考試。)
She passed the driving test.
(她通過了駕照考試。)

than(conj./prep.)比
(無詞性變化)
more than 超過
rather than 而不是
He is taller than me.
(他比我高。)
More than fifty people came.
(超過五十個人來了。)

thank(v./n.)感謝
thankful(adj.)感激的
thank you 謝謝你
thanks to 多虧
Thank you for your help.
(謝謝你的幫忙。)
Thanks to you, I passed the test.
(多虧了你，我考試及格了。)

that(conj./pron./adv./adj.)那、那個、那麼
(無詞性變化)
that is 也就是說
that way 那條路、那樣
That is my bike.
(那是我的腳踏車。)
I think that he is right.
(我認為他是對的。)

the(art.)這、那(定冠詞)
(無詞性變化)
the same 相同的
the best 最好的
The sun rises in the east.
(太陽從東方升起。)
Please close the door.
(請把門關上。)

theater(n.)劇院、電影院
theatre(n.)劇院(英式拼法)
movie theater 電影院
go to the theater 去看戲
Let's meet at the movie theater.
(我們在電影院見。)
The theater was full of people.
(劇院裡擠滿了人。)

then(adv./adj.)然後、那時、當時的
(無詞性變化)
since then 從那時起
just then 就在那時
Finish your homework, then watch TV.
(先寫完功課，再看電視。)
I was only six then.
(那時我才六歲。)

there(adv./n.)在那裡、那裡
(無詞性變化)
over there 在那邊
there is/are 有
There is a cat on the bed.
(床上有一隻貓。)
My bag is over there.
(我的包包在那邊。)

these(pron./adj.)這些
this(pron./adj.)這、這個
these days 最近
one of these 這些中的一個
These apples are very sweet.
(這些蘋果很甜。)
I am very busy these days.
(我最近很忙。)

they(pron.)他們、她們、它們
them(pron.)他們(受格)
their(pron.)他們的
theirs(pron.)他們的(東西)
themselves(pron.)他們自己
they say 據說
by themselves 他們獨自
They are my classmates.
(他們是我的同學。)
The kids cleaned the room by themselves.
(孩子們自己打掃了房間。)

thick(adj.)厚的、濃的
thickness(n.)厚度
thick book 厚書
thick fog 濃霧
This dictionary is very thick.
(這本字典很厚。)
There was thick fog this morning.
(今天早上起了濃霧。)

thin(adj.)薄的、瘦的
(無詞性變化)
thin paper 薄紙
get thin 變瘦
She is tall and thin.
(她又高又瘦。)
The ice is too thin to walk on.
(冰太薄了，不能在上面走。)

thing(n.)東西、事情
(無詞性變化)
the same thing 同樣的事
first thing 第一件事
What is that thing on the desk?
(桌上那個東西是什麼？)
I have many things to do today.
(我今天有很多事要做。)

think(v.)想、認為
thought(n.)想法
think about 考慮
think of 想到
I think it will rain today.
(我覺得今天會下雨。)
Let me think about it.
(讓我想一想。)

third(adj./n./adv.)第三(的)、三分之一
(無詞性變化)
third floor 三樓
one third 三分之一
He came in third in the race.
(他在賽跑中得到第三名。)
My office is on the third floor.
(我的辦公室在三樓。)

this(pron./adv./adj.)這、這個、這麼
(無詞性變化)
this morning 今天早上
like this 像這樣
This is my friend, Tom.
(這是我的朋友湯姆。)
Do it like this.
(像這樣做。)

those(pron./adj.)那些
that(pron./adj.)那、那個
those days 那些日子
those who 那些……的人
Those shoes are too big for me.
(那些鞋子對我來說太大了。)
I miss those days.
(我懷念那些日子。)

though(conj./adv.)雖然、不過
although(conj.)雖然
even though 即使
as though 好像
Though it was raining, we went out.
(雖然下著雨，我們還是出門了。)
It's hard. I like it, though.
(很難，不過我喜歡。)

thousand(n./adj.)千
(無詞性變化)
a thousand 一千
thousands of 成千上萬的
This bike cost five thousand dollars.
(這台腳踏車花了五千元。)
Thousands of people came to the concert.
(成千上萬的人來參加演唱會。)

throat(n.)喉嚨
(無詞性變化)
sore throat 喉嚨痛
clear one's throat 清喉嚨
I have a sore throat.
(我喉嚨痛。)
Drink warm water for your throat.
(喝溫水對喉嚨好。)

through(prep./adv.)穿過、通過、透過
throughout(prep.)遍及、從頭到尾
go through 經歷、穿過
through the window 透過窗戶
The train goes through a long tunnel.
(火車穿過一條長隧道。)
I learned about it through the news.
(我是透過新聞得知這件事的。)

throw(v./n.)丟、投擲
(無詞性變化)
throw away 丟掉
throw a ball 丟球
Don't throw trash on the street.
(不要在街上亂丟垃圾。)
He threw the ball to me.
(他把球丟給我。)

ticket(n.)票、罰單
(無詞性變化)
movie ticket 電影票
buy a ticket 買票
I bought two movie tickets.
(我買了兩張電影票。)
He got a parking ticket.
(他收到一張停車罰單。)

tidy(adj./v.)整齊的、整理
(無詞性變化)
tidy up 整理
a tidy room 整潔的房間
Please tidy up your room.
(請整理你的房間。)
Her desk is always tidy.
(她的書桌總是很整齊。)

tie(n./v.)領帶、平手、綁
(無詞性變化)
wear a tie 打領帶
tie one's shoes 綁鞋帶
My dad wears a tie to work.
(我爸爸打領帶上班。)
The game ended in a tie.
(比賽以平手結束。)

tiger(n.)老虎
(無詞性變化)
a wild tiger 野生老虎
the Year of the Tiger 虎年
The tiger is sleeping in the zoo.
(老虎在動物園裡睡覺。)
Tigers are big and strong.
(老虎又大又強壯。)

time(n./v.)時間、次數、計時
timer(n.)計時器
on time 準時
have a good time 玩得愉快
What time is it now?
(現在幾點？)
Please be on time for class.
(上課請準時。)

tip(n./v.)小費、訣竅、尖端、給小費
(無詞性變化)
give a tip 給小費
useful tips 實用的訣竅
Here are some tips for learning English.
(這裡有一些學英文的訣竅。)
We left a tip for the waiter.
(我們留了小費給服務生。)

tired(adj.)累的、厭倦的
tire(v.)使疲倦
be tired of 厭倦
feel tired 覺得累
I'm too tired to go out.
(我太累了，不想出門。)
I'm tired of eating noodles.
(我吃麵吃膩了。)

to(prep.)到、向、給
(無詞性變化)
go to 去
from A to B 從A到B
I go to school at seven.
(我七點去上學。)
Give the book to Amy.
(把書給艾美。)

today(adv./n.)今天、現今
(無詞性變化)
today's news 今日新聞
young people today 現今的年輕人
It is very hot today.
(今天很熱。)
What day is today?
(今天星期幾？)

toe(n.)腳趾
(無詞性變化)
big toe 大腳趾
on tiptoe 踮著腳
I hurt my big toe.
(我傷到了大腳趾。)
The water came up to my toes.
(水淹到了我的腳趾。)

together(adv.)一起
(無詞性變化)
get together 聚會
work together 合作
Let's eat lunch together.
(我們一起吃午餐吧。)
We work together on the project.
(我們一起合作做這個專題。)

toilet(n.)馬桶、廁所
(無詞性變化)
toilet paper 衛生紙
flush the toilet 沖馬桶
Where is the toilet?
(廁所在哪裡？)
Don't forget to flush the toilet.
(別忘了沖馬桶。)

tomato(n.)番茄
tomatoes(n.)番茄(複數)
tomato sauce 番茄醬
tomato juice 番茄汁
I put some tomatoes in the salad.
(我在沙拉裡放了一些番茄。)
She likes tomato juice.
(她喜歡番茄汁。)

tomorrow(adv./n.)明天
(無詞性變化)
see you tomorrow 明天見
tomorrow morning 明天早上
See you tomorrow!
(明天見！)
We have a test tomorrow morning.
(我們明天早上有考試。)

tonight(adv./n.)今晚
(無詞性變化)
tonight's dinner 今晚的晚餐
see you tonight 今晚見
What are you doing tonight?
(你今晚要做什麼？)
It may rain tonight.
(今晚可能會下雨。)

too(adv.)也、太
(無詞性變化)
too much 太多
me too 我也是
I like dogs, too.
(我也喜歡狗。)
This shirt is too big for me.
(這件襯衫對我來說太大了。)

tool(n.)工具
(無詞性變化)
useful tool 有用的工具
tool box 工具箱
A computer is a useful tool.
(電腦是很有用的工具。)
Dad keeps his tools in the box.
(爸爸把工具放在箱子裡。)

tooth(n.)牙齒
teeth(n.)牙齒(複數)
brush one's teeth 刷牙
sweet tooth 愛吃甜食
Brush your teeth before bed.
(睡前要刷牙。)
I have a sweet tooth.
(我很愛吃甜食。)

top(n./adj./v.)頂端、最高的、居首
(無詞性變化)
on top of 在……上面
top student 頂尖學生
We climbed to the top of the hill.
(我們爬到山頂。)
She is the top student in our class.
(她是我們班的第一名。)

topic(n.)話題、主題
(無詞性變化)
a hot topic 熱門話題
change the topic 換話題
What is the topic of your report?
(你的報告主題是什麼？)
Let's change the topic.
(我們換個話題吧。)

total(adj./n./v.)總計(的)、完全的、合計
totally(adv.)完全地
in total 總共
total cost 總費用
The total is five hundred dollars.
(總共是五百元。)
There are forty students in total.
(總共有四十個學生。)

touch(n./v.)接觸、觸摸、感動
touching(adj.)感人的
keep in touch 保持聯絡
Don't touch 請勿觸摸
Please don't touch the paintings.
(請勿觸摸畫作。)
Let's keep in touch.
(我們保持聯絡吧。)

towel(n./v.)毛巾、用毛巾擦
(無詞性變化)
bath towel 浴巾
paper towel 紙巾
Can I use your towel?
(我可以用你的毛巾嗎？)
He dried his hair with a towel.
(他用毛巾擦乾頭髮。)

town(n.)城鎮
(無詞性變化)
small town 小鎮
downtown 市中心
I grew up in a small town.
(我在一個小鎮長大。)
There is a night market in this town.
(這個小鎮有一個夜市。)

toy(n.)玩具
(無詞性變化)
toy car 玩具車
toy store 玩具店
My little brother has many toys.
(我弟弟有很多玩具。)
She bought a toy car for her son.
(她買了一台玩具車給兒子。)

traffic(n./v.)交通、車流
(無詞性變化)
traffic jam 塞車
traffic light 紅綠燈
We were late because of a traffic jam.
(我們因為塞車而遲到。)
Stop at the traffic light.
(在紅綠燈前停下來。)

train(n./v.)火車、訓練
training(n.)訓練
take a train 搭火車
train station 火車站
We took a train to Hualien.
(我們搭火車去花蓮。)
He trains hard every day.
(他每天努力訓練。)

treat(v.)對待、治療、請客、treatment(n.)對待、治療
(無詞性變化)
treat someone to 請某人吃……
medical treatment 醫療
Let me treat you to lunch.
(讓我請你吃午餐。)
She treats her dog like a baby.
(她把她的狗當成寶寶對待。)

tree(n.)樹
(無詞性變化)
plant a tree 種樹
Christmas tree 聖誕樹
There is a big tree in the park.
(公園裡有一棵大樹。)
We planted trees on Arbor Day.
(我們在植樹節種樹。)

trip(n./v.)旅行、絆倒
(無詞性變化)
take a trip 去旅行
school trip 校外教學
We took a trip to Kenting.
(我們去墾丁旅行。)
He tripped over a rock.
(他被一顆石頭絆倒。)

trouble(n./v.)麻煩、困擾、使煩惱
troublesome(adj.)麻煩的
in trouble 有麻煩
have trouble 有困難
He is in big trouble.
(他麻煩大了。)
I have trouble sleeping at night.
(我晚上睡不好。)

truck(n.)卡車
(無詞性變化)
garbage truck 垃圾車
truck driver 卡車司機
The garbage truck comes at eight.
(垃圾車八點來。)
A big truck is parked outside.
(外面停了一台大卡車。)

try(v./n.)嘗試、努力、試穿
(無詞性變化)
try on 試穿
try one's best 盡全力
Can I try on this jacket?
(我可以試穿這件外套嗎？)
I will try my best.
(我會盡全力。)

T-shirt(n.)T恤
(無詞性變化)
white T-shirt 白色T恤
wear a T-shirt 穿T恤
He is wearing a white T-shirt.
(他穿著一件白色T恤。)
I bought a T-shirt at the shop.
(我在店裡買了一件T恤。)

turn(v./n.)轉、轉向、輪流
(無詞性變化)
turn on 打開(電器)
take turns 輪流
Turn left at the corner.
(在轉角左轉。)
It's your turn to sing.
(輪到你唱了。)

twice(adv.)兩次、兩倍
(無詞性變化)
twice a week 一週兩次
think twice 三思
I play basketball twice a week.
(我一週打兩次籃球。)
Think twice before you speak.
(說話前要三思。)

type(n./v.)類型、打字
typical(adj.)典型的
blood type 血型
type fast 打字很快
What type of music do you like?
(你喜歡哪種類型的音樂？)
She can type very fast.
(她打字很快。)

uncle(n.)叔叔、伯伯、舅舅
(無詞性變化)
my uncle 我的叔叔
